_comment: Hand-maintained agency attribution overrides (see data/DATA.md). Each entry is { "domain": "host or full URL", "agency": "Exact agency name" }. An explicit entry WINS over the automated (axe Monitor) attribution: it fills a site that is currently Unattributed and can correct a mis-attributed one. The agency string must match an existing agency name EXACTLY, or the site forms its own rollup bucket — the generator logs any name it doesn't recognize. Re-run `npm run generate:offline` after editing.

overrides.agency: New York State Financial Control Board
